description:
Review uncommitted vault changes, then stage and commit them to git.

Subcommands:
  review [--max-file-lines N] [--max-lines N] — show every change since the last commit; read-only
  save --message SUBJECT [--body TEXT] [--dry-run] — stage every change in the vault and commit

Flags:
  review:
    --max-file-lines N  max diff lines per file (default 150)
    --max-lines N       max output lines overall (default 3000)
  save:
    --message SUBJECT  required; one non-empty line
    --body TEXT        commit body; may span multiple lines
    --dry-run          report what would be staged and committed; change nothing

Examples:
  ["review"]
  ["save", "--message", "Northwind: kickoff notes, two tasks, 3h logged", "--body", "Added meeting note and actions for Sam Rivera.\nLogged workshop prep hours."]
  ["save", "--message", "Flush buffer", "--dry-run"]

Notes:
  Run review first, write an accurate summary of what changed, then save with it.
  save stages everything in the vault. It only ever adds a commit; it never amends, rebases, resets or pushes.
  Exit 1: --message empty or multi-line; vault is not a git repository or not its root; a git command failed.
